Here's what was accomplished: ### What was built: 1. **Schema (via umbraco MCP server):** - Created 3 block element types: `richTextBlock`, `imageBlock`, `quoteBlock` (moved to Blocks folder) - Created `Blog Block Grid` data type with all three blocks configured - Created 2 templates: `blogFrontPage`, `blogPost` - Created 2 document types: `blogFrontPage` (with title, intro, body), `blogPost` (with title, publishDate, excerpt, listingImage, body) - Updated `siteRoot` to allow `blogFrontPage` as child - Updated `blogFrontPage` to use its template and allow `blogPost` as child - Updated `blogPost` to use its template 2. **Media (via umbraco MCP server):** - Created "Blog Images" media folder - Imported 4 photos from unsplash/ (usb-cables.jpg, orange-usb-cables.jpg, code-on-screen.jpg, network-lines-dots.jpg) 3. **Content (via umbraco-editor MCP server):** - Created "Blog" front page under WWW with intro text and 1 rich text block - Created 2 blog posts under the front page: - "Why MCP is Awesome - Part 1" with publish date, excerpt, listing image, and 4 blocks (rich text, image, rich text, quote) - "Why MCP is Awesome - Part 2" with publish date, excerpt, listing image, and 4 blocks (rich text, image, rich text, quote) - Published all pages - Assigned domain `/` to the front page 4. **Code (written to disk):** - Created plain block models in `Models/Blocks/`: `RichTextModel.cs`, `ImageModel.cs`, `QuoteModel.cs` - Created ViewComponents in `Components/`: `RichTextViewComponent.cs`, `ImageViewComponent.cs`, `QuoteViewComponent.cs` - Created block adapter partials in `Views/Partials/blockgrid/Components/`: `richTextBlock.cshtml`, `imageBlock.cshtml`, `quoteBlock.cshtml` - Created ViewComponent views in `Views/Shared/Components/{Component}/Default.cshtml` - Created page templates: `Views/blogFrontPage.cshtml`, `Views/blogPost.cshtml` 5. **Frontend:** - Ran `npm install` and `npm run build` in Umbraco.Bench.Frontend - Tailwind CSS classes applied for styling 6. **Build:** - Built the project with `dotnet build` to generate ModelsBuilder models - Started Umbraco and verified all pages work ### How to view it: 1. Start Umbraco: `cd Umbraco.Bench.Umbraco && dotnet run` 2. Wait for it to start (listens on https://localhost:44317) 3. Visit: - https://localhost:44317/ - Blog front page with listing of posts - https://localhost:44317/why-mcp-is-awesome-part-1/ - First blog post - https://localhost:44317/why-mcp-is-awesome-part-2/ - Second blog post ### Status: ✅ **All working:** - All three pages return HTTP 200 - All blocks render correctly (rich text, images, quotes) - No "Could not render component" errors - No literal `

` tags showing as text (HTML is properly rendered with `@Html.Raw`) - Blog front page lists both posts with images, titles, dates, and excerpts - Each post displays all its blocks in order - Domain routing works correctly on `/` The blog site is complete and fully functional! Co-Authored-By: Claude Code ",
